The packaging on this product has had an update. You may receive this product in either the packaging shown or the old packaging. There is no changes to the specification.

Water-based, moisture-resistant, multi-surface paint with a tough and durable mid-sheen satin finish. Suitable for interior surfaces such as walls and ceilings. Also suitable for interior wood including internal doors, plaster plus wallboard, concrete, cement rendering, brickwork and blockwork. Can also be used on metal, such as radiators. Designed to eliminate the need for multiple products when painting a room.
b: Suitable for Walls, Ceilings, Metal & Wood
